environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2 in us-east-1. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority 1 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet priority 2 in default BLOCK mode, (3) a custom rule group priority 3 with a RegexPatternSet matching URI path ^/api/.* that applies a SqliMatchStatement on AllQueryArguments with sensitivity level HIGH and TextTransformation URL_DECODE+HTML_ENTITY_DECODE+COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE, action BLOCK. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule evaluations. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (VPC with no NAT gateway, no internet gateway on the private subnet, only VPC endpoint for ECR and S3), preventing any out-of-band data exfiltration channels.

config.network: private subnet, no NAT, no IGW, VPC endpoints for ECR/S3/CloudWatch only
config.security_group_egress: only to VPC endpoint prefix lists
